claims: The 98th Academy Awards take place on March 15, 2026.
Ryan Coogler's Sinners received 16 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another received 13 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is hosted by Conan O'Brien at the Dolby Theatre.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will be broadcast live on ABC and Hulu on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Sinners broke the record for most nominations by a single film with 16 nominations.
One Battle After Another secured 13 nominations including Best Director and Best Picture.
Fire and Ash received two nominations.
Sinners is a Netflix/Warner Bros production.
Bugonia is a Focus Features production.
The Best Picture nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Sinners, One Battle After Another, Bugonia, Marty Supreme, Hamnet, The Secret Agent, F1, Frankenstein, Train Dreams, Sentimental Value.

The Best Actor nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Leonardo DiCaprio (One Battle After Another), Michael B. Jordan (Sinners), Timothée Chalamet (Marty Supreme), Ethan Hawke (Blue Moon), Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent).

The Best Actress nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Emma Stone (Bugonia), Jessie Buckley (Hamnet), Renate Reinsve (Sentimental Value), Kate Hudson (Song Sung Blue), Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I'd Kick You).

The Best Director nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Ryan Coogler (Sinners), Paul Thomas Anderson (One Battle After Another), Yorgos Lanthimos (Bugonia), Josh Safdie (Marty Supreme), Kleber Mendonça Filho (The Secret Agent).
The Best Supporting Actor nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Jacob Elordi (Frankenstein), Delroy Lindo (Sinners).
The Best Supporting Actress nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Amy Madigan (Weapons), Wunmi Mosaku (Sinners), Elle Fanning (Sentimental Value).
Animated Feature nominees for the 98th Academy Awards include KPop Demon Hunters, Elio, Zootopia 2, Arco, and Little Amélie or the Character of Rain.
